cases.name: stepinfo_model
cases.code: G=tf(1,[1 0.4 1]); t=(0:0.01:40)'; S=stepinfo(G,t); v0=S.RiseTime; v1=S.SettlingTime; v2=S.Overshoot; v3=S.Undershoot; v4=S.Peak; v5=S.PeakTime; v6=S.SettlingMin; v7=S.SettlingMax;

cases.name: stepinfo_data
cases.code: G=tf(1,[1 0.4 1]); t=(0:0.01:40)'; y=step(G,t); S=stepinfo(y,t); v0=S.RiseTime; v1=S.SettlingTime; v2=S.Overshoot; v3=S.Undershoot; v4=S.Peak; v5=S.PeakTime; v6=S.SettlingMin; v7=S.SettlingMax;

cases.name: dense_hessenberg_parallel
cases.code: n=64; A=-diag(1:n)+0.002*ones(n); B=reshape(sin(1:n*2),n,2); C=reshape(cos(1:n*2),2,n); G=ss(A,B,C,zeros(2)); w=logspace(-2,2,200); H=freqresp(G,w); E=evalfr(G,0.3+0.7i);
